# Memory Map

> Private, browser-local analysis of a ChatGPT export into evidence-linked memory and longitudinal insights.

## Product

- [Home](https://chatgpt.significanthobbies.com/): Local ChatGPT export analysis
- [What it finds](https://chatgpt.significanthobbies.com/about/): Capabilities and privacy architecture
- [Changelog](https://chatgpt.significanthobbies.com/changelog/): Verified product releases

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://chatgpt.significanthobbies.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://chatgpt.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API description
- [Homepage markdown](https://chatgpt.significanthobbies.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
- [This index](https://chatgpt.significanthobbies.com/llms.txt)

## When to use this

- Analyzing a ChatGPT export locally for memory patterns and longitudinal insights
- Discovering evidence-linked themes and reflection questions from conversation history
- Understanding the privacy architecture of browser-local ChatGPT analysis (no server upload)
- Checking what capabilities the Memory Map tool finds in ChatGPT exports
